interface.title: OpenDose: curve fitting & biostatistics in your browser (v0.4.0)
interface.field: Biomedical lab science: pharmacology, immunoassay, molecular biology and preclinical biostatistics
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis and reporting after the bench assay: entering data, choosing a test, fitting or testing, then graphs, results sentences, methods text and export
interface.what_it_is_for: A spreadsheet-style project workspace like GraphPad Prism where a researcher enters assay data, is guided to the right analysis, and fits dose-response or standard curves or runs t tests, ANOVA, survival and qPCR statistics in the browser with SciPy, getting publication-ready graphs and report text.

data.note: I opened the built-in example project with ?example=1. It holds an XY dose-response table (Drug A, 9 concentrations × 3 replicates), a 2×2 contingency table and a two-group survival table. I also used the built-in example data in the Plate-reader and qPCR assays, and typed a small 3-group column table myself. The Pyodide engine never loaded: every engine file request returned the SPA's HTML page. The app's own error says 'could not load the engine files (the server returned a web page instead of the engine files)', and opening /py/opendose/__init__.py directly gives the app shell (screens/005.webp). This fits the predev sync-py step not having run. Results computed earlier for the example (dose-response fit, Kaplan-Meier) show briefly while the engine retries after a sheet switch. No live computation happened anywhere, and trying localhost:5173 did not help. Some lists that depend on the engine, such as the curve-fit model catalogue, may also have shown only a fallback.
